description: A link that opens the wallet's Withdraw form for the PERSON who taps it, with your address (and optionally network, amount, memo) filled in — they confirm the withdrawal from their own balance. No app money moves. 403 `withdrawal_link_unavailable` while the feature is off.

amount.description: Decimal string in MAJOR units, e.g. "5" = 5 USDT. Never a float. Optional.

memo.description: Memo / tag, on networks that have one.

network.description: Network code; needed only when the address fits several.

name: createWithdrawalLink
